title: Mohnish Pabrai Lecture at Univ. of California, Irvine (UCI), May 24, 2016
summary: If you look at the C's candy purchase from 1972 and take it all the way till today, unit volume growth of C's has been about approximately 2 per cent. C's did not keep up with California GDP growth over that period from a volume growth perspective and in fact even the 2 per cent volume growth that has come in with square footage increase. So their retail space went up by approximately that number which led to that growth.
